description: This file defines a React component named 'Users' that manages the display and interaction with a list of users, including search, pagination, and conditional rendering based on loading state and search results.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A React component extending React.PureComponent that handles user list display, search, and pagination.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state with a search string.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the initial list of users when the component mounts.

methods.description: Handles user input for searching users; triggers search if input length >= 2.

methods.name: handleOnPagination
methods.description: Handles pagination events to fetch users for the selected page.

methods.description: Renders the user dashboard, including search, list, pagination, and conditional messages.
